issues: 字里透出的是一张白色 dashboard，白底卡片塞进字形里只读成一行普通的浅紫白字，看不出"窗里有画面"
放大接管是匀速胀开，没有预备动作，冲击力弱；接管后是灰白小字的占位 dashboard
暗场 + 靛紫色调与库里大量暗场镜头雷同，字和背景之间没有空间关系
副题只有一行小字，字形 360px 只占画面一半宽
changes: look 换为 porcelain：冷白瓷舞台 + 主光 + 暗角，字形下垫一层带色相的软投影，470px Black 字像被挖进舞台的一扇窗
窗里换成为镜头设计的暗色实时面板（Meridian · Throughput）：钴蓝→青的流式面积图一直在流、请求数计数、柱图呼吸，亮线穿过字的腰线
节奏改为：遮罩自基线擦出 → 78f 字内漂移 → 8f 吸气（字 1→0.965）→ 24f 对数空间 t^1.8 加速冲入 46×；冲入时把 L 竖笔拉回画面中线
接管层只在竖笔撑满全屏（≈24×）之后才换层，消除灰纱；面板 1.32→1 expo-out 晚 4f 落定到标准构图
加入眉题 MERIDIAN CLOUD 与 40px 副题，冲入前退场；结尾停在完整的全屏面板，流式图仍在流动；时长 150→165f
issuesEn: The letters reveal a white dashboard, so white cards inside the glyphs just read as plain pale lavender type rather than a window onto something
The takeover is a uniform swell with no anticipation, so it lacks punch, and it lands on a placeholder dashboard of small grey text
Dark stage with an indigo tint looks like many other dark shots in the library, and there is no spatial relationship between word and background
Only one small line of subtitle, and the 360px word covers about half the frame width
changesEn: Look switched to porcelain: a cool white stage with key light and vignette; a tinted soft shadow under the glyphs makes the 470px black-weight word read as a window cut into the stage

Inside the window is a purpose-built dark live dashboard (Meridian / Throughput): a cobalt-to-teal streaming area chart that keeps flowing, a counting request rate and breathing bars, with the bright line running through the letters' waist

Re-timed: the mask wipes up from the baseline, 78f of drift inside the letters, an 8f breath (word 1 to 0.965), then a 24f log-space t^1.8 accelerating rush to 46x that also pulls the L stem to frame centre
The full-screen cover layer only switches in once the stem fills the frame (about 24x), removing the grey veil; the panel settles from 1.32 to 1 with expo-out, 4f behind the rush
Added a MERIDIAN CLOUD eyebrow and a 40px subline that exit before the rush; the shot ends on the complete full-screen dashboard with the chart still streaming; duration 150 to 165f
